description: This file provides Foreign Function Interface (FFI) bindings in Rust for interacting with C code related to Android's KeyMint Trusted Application (TA) core in the Cuttlefish project. It defines a single externally visible function `kmr_ta_main` that wraps a call to `kmr_cf::ta_main`, handling security level validation and safety guarantees around file descriptors.
